jesus.name: Jesus of Nazareth
jesus.role: Teacher presented as the Christ and Son of God
jesus.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
jesus.importance: John baptizes him in the Jordan. He teaches, heals, and casts out demons in Galilee. He tells his disciples three times that he will be killed and rise. He is crucified, and a young man at the tomb says he has risen.
jesus.connections: Mary is his mother. Mark names four brothers and mentions his sisters.

word.languageNote: This is the dictionary form of the name “Jesus.”

mary-mother.name: Mary, mother of Jesus
mary-mother.role: Mother named in the hometown discussion
mary-mother.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
mary-mother.importance: She comes with Jesus’ brothers and stands outside, calling for him. Jesus says that whoever does God’s will is his family. People in his own country later call him the son of Mary.
mary-mother.connections: Jesus is her son. People name James, Joses, Judah, and Simon as his brothers.

john-baptizer.name: John the Baptizer
john-baptizer.role: Preacher who baptizes Jesus and dies under Herod’s order
john-baptizer.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
john-baptizer.importance: He baptizes in the wilderness and says a mightier one comes after him. He baptizes Jesus in the Jordan. He tells Herod that his marriage is not lawful. Herod has him beheaded to keep an oath made at a supper.
john-baptizer.connections: King Herod puts him in prison for the sake of Herodias. His disciples bury his body.

word.languageNote: This is the dictionary form of the name “John.”

peter.name: Simon Peter
peter.role: Fisherman who follows Jesus and later denies knowing him
peter.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
peter.importance: Simon leaves his nets, and Jesus names him Peter. He calls Jesus the Christ, then rebukes him for speaking of death. He says he will not deny Jesus, then denies him three times and weeps. The young man at the tomb sends word to “his disciples and Peter.”
peter.connections: Andrew is his brother. Jesus heals his wife’s mother of a fever.

word.languageNote: This is the dictionary form of the name “Peter.”

mary-magdalene.name: Mary Magdalene
mary-magdalene.role: Witness of the cross, burial, and opened tomb
mary-magdalene.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
mary-magdalene.importance: She watches the cross from afar and sees where Jesus is laid. She brings spices to the tomb and hears that he has risen. The women flee and say nothing, for they are afraid. Jesus then appears to her first, but the others do not believe her.
mary-magdalene.connections: She goes with Salome and with Mary the mother of James and Joses. Jesus had cast seven demons out of her.

word.languageNote: This is the dictionary form of the name “Mary.”
